The Country Director will lead Jhpiego Philippines into its next phase of impact and growth, continuing to build an influential, technically and financially sustainable country platform. The country lead will position Jhpiego as a strategic thought leader and implementer to government, private sector and communities to solve complex health-system challenges and taking proven solutions to scale. Location: Manila, Philippines Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Provide vision and direction for Jhpiego Philippines, translating Jhpiego’s global strategy and organizational priorities into a relevant and actionable country strategy. Strengthen Jhpiego’s positioning as a trusted technical partner in primary health care, maternal, newborn and child health, family planning and reproductive health, adolescent and youth health, immunization, women’s cancers, gender, global health security and other emerging priorities. Guide the country program’s transition toward greater systems design, institutionalization, policy influence and sustainable scale. Identify and ensure projects respond to emerging health, demographic, technological, environmental and financing trends that may affect Jhpiego’s work in the Philippines. Foster a culture of innovation, learning and performance in the team to drive growth and positive outcomes. Participate actively in relevant subnational, national, regional and global leadership forums and contribute to organization-wide priorities, learning and growth. Strategic Growth and Partnerships Develop and execute a country growth strategy with clear targets for portfolio growth, revenue diversification, new partnerships and financial sustainability. Build and manage a qualified opportunity pipeline, prioritizing opportunities based on strategic fit, competitive advantage, probability of success, potential impact and financial viability. Diversify funding and partnerships by cultivating government, bilateral and multilateral donors, foundations, corporations, philanthropies, research institutions and private-sector partners. Lead or oversee the development of competitive, technically strong and cost-conscious proposals. Ensure that proposals present credible implementation models, clear value for money, realistic staffing and budgets, and pathways to sustainability. Explore appropriate public-private partnerships, co-financing arrangements, catalytic funding and other responsible financing approaches. Provide strong representation of Jhpiego at public facing events – including preparing and delivering high quality presentations at national and international fora. Technical and Program Quality Assurance Provide strategic oversight of Jhpiego’s portfolio in the Philippines, ensuring that programs achieve agreed objectives, results and contractual requirements. Maintain high standards of technical and program quality across all projects. Ensure that programs use evidence-based approaches adapted to Philippine contexts and designed with government, health workers, communities, women, adolescents and other intended users. Promote integration across technical areas rather than fragmented, disease-specific implementation where integrated approaches would produce stronger outcomes. Ensure that programs strengthen national and local systems, including governance, service delivery, workforce capacity, quality improvement, referral systems, surveillance, supply systems, information systems and community engagement. Strengthen mechanisms for technical quality assurance, supportive supervision, routine program review and corrective action. Ensure appropriate engagement of Jhpiego global and regional technical experts in program design, implementation, review and learning. Financial Stewardship and Compliance Ensure sound financial management of all projects and country-office operations. Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, expenditure review and financial scenario planning. Lead periodic portfolio reviews that integrate programmatic, technical, financial, operational and risk information. Ensure that resources are allocated according to strategic priorities, award requirements and expected results. Monitor revenue, expenditure, indirect-cost recovery, pipeline, staffing liabilities and other indicators of financial health. Maintain appropriate financial controls and ensure timely corrective action when variances or control weaknesses are identified. Ensure that country-office structures and systems are proportionate to the size, complexity and funding outlook of the portfolio. Promote cost efficiency without compromising program quality, safeguarding, compliance or staff wellbeing. Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting to donors, Jhpiego leadership and other authorized stakeholders. Work with relevant corporate teams to manage shared costs, project closeout, asset management and financial risks. Ensure that financial projections are realistic and that programmatic commitments are supported by confirmed or reasonably anticipated resources. Respond to all requests from compliance team and alert them as soon as possible to any potential incident. Human Resource Management Build and lead a cohesive, diverse, inclusive and high-performing Senior Management Team. Establish clear roles, decision rights and accountability across country-office leadership and project teams. Recruit and retain highly qualified, mission-aligned staff across technical, programmatic and operational functions. Ensure effective onboarding, objective setting, performance review, coaching, recognition and professional development. Build a culture of learning, collaboration, respectful challenge and continuous improvement. Supervision Provides coaching, guidance and mentorship to direct report(s) where needed. Sets targets and objectives for assigned area and delivers results. Grows team expertise to align with program and organizational direction while continually looking for ways to provide / enhance the value delivered. Tracks, monitors and effectively addresses and / or rewards performance of team members. Manages employees in compliance with all HR policies, procedures, guidelines. Shares knowledge, information, skills and subject matter expertise among the team and ensures the timely communication of issues while encouraging good working relationships with other functions / teams. Recruits for all hires to ensure a highly diverse, qualified workforce with the necessary capabilities needed to achieve goals. Required Qualifications Advanced degree in public health, health administration, public administration, business administration or related degree Over 15 years of progressively responsible international public health management experience including design, implementation, monitori ng , reporting, and financial management (5+ years’ experience must have been as Project Director, DCOP, COP, or Country Director) Ability to travel locally and internationally for up to 30% – valid passport Required Skills Portfolio growth: Increase the scale and strategic relevance of Jhpiego’s portfolio through a strong opportunity pipeline, competitive proposals and high-value partnerships. Revenue diversification: Reduce concentration risk by expanding funding across bilateral and multilateral donors, foundations, corporations, the private sector and other appropriate financing mechanisms. Technical excellence: Ensure that Jhpiego’s work is evidence-based, locally relevant, innovative and capable of influencing policy, standards and national and subnational practice. Program excellence: Deliver projects on time, within budget and to the highest standards of quality, compliance, equity and measurable impact. HR: Proven track record in successfully managing recruitment, professional development, and managing HR issues. Coaching/mentoring skills: Technical skills to coach, mentor and develop technical capacity in program and technical staff. Compliance: Understanding of different donor’s regulations and reporting requirements, knowledge of local laws related to HR and finance, and experience ensuring a compliant workplace and how to deal with incidents. Preferred Qualifications Competencies : Growth Leadership: Builds a diversified opportunity pipeline, cultivates new funding sources and converts strategic positioning into sustainable portfolio growth. Future-Focused Strategy: Anticipates changes in the Philippine health and financing environment and translates them into measurable strategic priorities, new opportunities and scalable solutions. Innovation and Adaptive Execution: Uses data, technology and systems thinking to solve complex problems, manage uncertainty and accelerate organizational and program performance. Partnerships and Influence: Mobilizes government, donors, communities, academia and the private sector around shared priorities, sustainable financing and health-system transformation. Transformational Leadership and Communication: Inspires high-performing teams, develops future leaders and communicates Jhpiego’s value through credible evidence, influential ideas and compelling impact narratives. Problem solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. Proven ability to work in a complex environment charged with multiple tasks, short deadlines and intense pressure to perform. Communications: Ability to communicate effectively, instilling trust and confidence. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills - strong oral, written communication, and presentations skills as evidenced by publications Team leader: Proven experience in leading highly skilled and qualified staff (evidence of leading a technical and program team of more than 50 staff), including administrative and finance personnel and fostering a team environment where personnel thrive. Deadline for applications is Friday, 27th November, 2026. Applications may close earlier as we are reviewing applications on a rolling basis. Applicants must submit a single document for upload to include : cover letter and resume. For further information about Jhpiego, visit our website at www.jhpiego.org Note: The successful candidate selected for this position will be subject to a pre-employment background investigation.
